Download the closed trades of the backtest Id provided. The /backtests/export/trades API accepts requests in the following format:

ExportBacktestTradesRequest Model - Request to download the closed trades of a backtest.
backtestId string
required
example: 26c7bb06b8487cff1c7b3c44652b30f1
Id of the backtest from which to download the closed trades.
Example 
{
  "backtestId": "26c7bb06b8487cff1c7b3c44652b30f1"
}
